style: Same dark-gold editorial system as this video's sibling pieces (pricing-tiers-reveal / revenue-math-reveal / demand-reputation-flywheel / google-3-pack-stat / seo-search-intent / seo-foundation-vs-ads): near-black radial bg, League Gothic display caps, Montserrat labels, gold accent glow, restrained motion. Full-frame alpha-overlay replacement for a talking-head shot. A 24-hour clock-dial motif: a marker sweeps once around a ring while three moments in a contractor's day crossfade against a persistent, pulsing 'website' icon at the dial's center, closing on a direct echo of the source line.

customize.note: Hand-authored, no live catalog search performed (matching this same video's established precedent on revenue-math-reveal / demand-reputation-flywheel / seo-foundation-vs-ads: a hand-built clock-dial + crossfading beat-caption chassis has no direct catalog analog, and reusing a generic block would break the project's exact CSS custom-property brand system). Reuses this project's proven local primitives verbatim: :root palette tokens, #bg-fill radial reveal, .scene/.clip padding contract, eyebrow kicker style, back.out/power2.out entrance eases, and the freeze-hold-to-end closing pattern with a text-shadow glow pulse (from seo-foundation-vs-ads). Style source of truth: the two most recently built siblings in this video (seo-search-intent, seo-foundation-vs-ads) plus pricing-tiers-reveal/revenue-math-reveal/demand-reputation-flywheel/google-3-pack-stat, all on identical --bg:#0b0a08/--accent:#d9a94a tokens. NOTE: piece-01-website and icon-24-7-gear (also named as references in the brief) use a different, older purple palette (--bg:#0d0817/--accent:#9b5cff) not shared by any of the gold-system pieces — treated as a superseded era and NOT followed, since the two closest-in-time/placement siblings and the majority of the video's pieces are unanimous on gold. This is the one assumption made without a clarifying question, per the brief's own instruction to proceed autonomously on background work.

scenes.emotion: calm establishing open — the clock-dial chassis and center website icon build in, nothing moving yet
scenes.motion: bg-fill fade_in at 0.05s; eyebrow slide_top+fade_in at 0.15s; dial ring (SVG ring + hour-tick circle) scale_grow back.out at 0.25s; center browser-chip website icon scale_grow back.out at 0.55s; orbit marker dot pops in at 0.75s

scenes.text: ON THE JOB SITE / EXPLAINING SERVICES
scenes.emotion: first beat of the day-cycle — the marker sweeps from 12 o'clock toward the job-site mark while the website keeps working
scenes.motion: marker begins one continuous linear 360deg sweep of the dial at 0.9s (duration 7s, completes at 7.9s); beat-1 caption pair (hard-hat icon + 'ON THE JOB SITE' kicker, 'EXPLAINING SERVICES' action line) crossfades in at 1.75s; on the marker landing the job-site tick (~2.07s) the center website icon does a scale pulse + glow-ring ping and the matching dial tick brightens; beat-1 caption crossfades out at 3.85s

scenes.emotion: second beat — night, lowest point of the dial (6 o'clock/bottom), the website still answers
scenes.motion: beat-2 caption pair (moon icon + 'ASLEEP' kicker, 'ANSWERING QUESTIONS' action) crossfades in at 4.1s in the same caption slot as beat-1; on the marker landing the asleep tick (~4.4s) the center icon pulses + glow-ring pings again and that dial tick brightens; beat-2 caption crossfades out at 6.15s

scenes.emotion: third beat — evening, the website converts the moment they can't be at their phone
scenes.motion: beat-3 caption pair (house icon + 'WITH FAMILY' kicker, 'CAPTURING A LEAD' action) crossfades in at 6.45s; on the marker landing the family tick (~6.73s) the center icon pulses + glow-ring pings + a small '+1 LEAD' notification badge pops in back.out at 6.85s beside the icon; the whole dial group (ring, icon, marker, badge, caption) dims to 0.15 opacity at 7.9s to hand focus to the closing line

scenes.emotion: resolved, confident close — direct echo of the source line's own words, freeze-hold for a clean cut back to host footage
scenes.motion: closing headline fade_up+slide at 8.05s with a text-shadow glow pulse at 8.5s (yoyo, reused from seo-foundation-vs-ads's closing pattern); hold to 9.5s, no further tweens
